# Praiser — full description

> A free AI that praises, hypes and celebrates anyone: friend, family, partner, hero. English and Greek, voice and live conversation, no signup. https://praiser.6x7.gr · Made by 6x7 (https://6x7.gr).

## What it does
Tell Praiser about someone. In here we only speak well of them. Send a question, an image or a voice note, and it always finds what's praiseworthy, with specific, warm detail rather than generic flattery.

## Ways to use it
- **Ode:** write a short ode to someone.
- **Photo:** send a photo of someone and get something nice said about them.
- **Lore:** tell the story of someone.
- **Tender:** three things that make someone special.
- **Personas:** have the praise written in the voice of Socrates, Mr. Rogers, Mary Oliver, Bob Ross, Marcus Aurelius, Carl Sagan, Ada Lovelace or Heracles.
- **Voice:** record a voice note, or have a live spoken conversation.

## Good for
Birthday and anniversary messages, wedding toasts, retirement and farewell cards, thank-you notes for teachers and colleagues, eulogies and tributes, cheering up a friend, or just saying out loud what you love about someone.

## Languages
English and Greek (switch in the header).

## Privacy and accounts
No signup needed to use it. Recent chats appear in the sidebar history; an account is optional.

## Pricing
Free.
